// DATA STORAGE DOCUMENTATION - Tamil Master App
// =============================================

// ============================================
// 1. FIREBASE FIRESTORE COLLECTIONS
// ============================================

// Collection: users
// Stores: User profiles and authentication data
// Fields:
//   - uid: User ID (auto-generated by Firebase Auth)
//   - email: User email
//   - displayName: User's display name
//   - photoURL: User's profile photo
//   - role: 'student', 'teacher', 'parent', 'admin'
//   - lastLogin: Timestamp of last login
//   - createdAt: Account creation timestamp
//   - progress: User's learning progress (synced from local)
//   - lastSync: Last sync timestamp

// Collection: daily_words
// Stores: Daily Tamil power words posted by admin
// Fields:
//   - word: Tamil word
//   - english: English meaning
//   - sentence: Example sentence
//   - date: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format
//   - createdAt: Timestamp when added

// Collection: topics
// Stores: Learning topics/lessons
// Fields:
//   - title: Topic name
//   - order: Display order
//   - status: 'unlocked' or 'locked'
//   - createdAt: Timestamp

// Collection: stories
// Stores: Tamil moral stories
// Fields:
//   - title: Story title
//   - content: Story content
//   - createdAt: Timestamp

// Collection: rhymes
// Stores: Tamil rhymes/poems
// Fields:
//   - title: Rhyme title
//   - content: Rhyme content
//   - createdAt: Timestamp

// Collection: discussions
// Stores: Classroom chat messages
// Fields:
//   - sender: Name of sender
//   - message: Message content
//   - timestamp: Message timestamp

// Collection: tasks
// Stores: Homework and quiz assignments
// Fields:
//   - title: Task title
//   - type: 'Task' or 'Quiz'
//   - createdAt: Timestamp

// Collection: settings
// Document: global_notice
// Stores: Global announcements
// Fields:
//   - message: Notice message
//   - updatedAt: Last update timestamp

// ============================================
// 2. LOCAL STORAGE (SharedPreferences)
// ============================================

// User Progress Data (Synced to Firebase):
//   - userName: Student's name
//   - avatar: Student's emoji avatar
//   - region: Student's region
//   - level: Current level (1-100+)
//   - totalCoins: Total coins earned
//   - totalStars: Total stars earned
//   - streakDays: Consecutive login days
//   - totalLettersLearned: Letters learned count
//   - quizScore: Total quiz score
//   - achievementBadges: List of earned badges
//   - inventory: List of purchased items
//   - unlockedLessons: List of unlocked lesson IDs
//   - lessonProgressMap: Progress per lesson (key:value pairs)
//   - storyScoresMap: Quiz scores per story (key:value pairs)
//   - dailyMissions: Daily mission progress
//   - isTeacherMode: Teacher mode toggle
//   - globalNotice: Current notice message

// Authentication Data:
//   - saved_email: Saved email for auto-login
//   - saved_password: Saved password for auto-login
//   - remember_me: Auto-login preference
//   - lastLoginDate: Last login date for streak calculation

// ============================================
// 3. DATA SYNC FLOW
// ============================================

// On App Start:
// 1. Check if user is authenticated (Firebase Auth)
// 2. If authenticated:
//    a. Try to fetch progress from Firebase
//    b. If found: Load from Firebase, sync to local storage
//    c. If not found: Load from local storage, sync to Firebase
// 3. If not authenticated: Load from local storage only

// On User Action (Coins, Stars, Achievements, etc.):
// 1. Update local storage immediately (fast)
// 2. Call syncToCloud() to update Firebase (background)

// On Logout:
// 1. Clear local storage
// 2. Clear Firebase session

// ============================================
// 4. DATA STORED BY FEATURE
// ============================================

// LOGIN SCREEN:
// - Email, Password (local only, not stored)
// - Remember Me preference (local)
// - Saved credentials (local, encrypted by OS)

// PROFILE SCREEN:
// - User name (local + Firebase)
// - Avatar emoji (local + Firebase)
// - Level (local + Firebase)
// - Stars, Coins (local + Firebase)
// - Streak days (local + Firebase)
// - Achievement badges (local + Firebase)

// TAMIL LETTERS SCREEN:
// - Letters learned count (local + Firebase)
// - Letter progress (local + Firebase)

// WRITING PRACTICE:
// - Drawing strokes (not stored, real-time only)
// - Coins/Stars earned (local + Firebase)

// QUIZ SCREEN:
// - Quiz scores (local + Firebase)
// - Quiz progress (local + Firebase)

// CLASSROOM CONNECT:
// - Messages (Firebase only)
// - Tasks/Homework (Firebase only)
// - Discussions (Firebase only)

// ADMIN CONTROL:
// - Daily words (Firebase only)
// - Topics (Firebase only)
// - User roles (Firebase only)
// - Global notice (Firebase + local cache)

// ============================================
// 5. SYNC METHODS
// ============================================

// syncToCloud():
// - Called after every user action
// - Uploads all progress data to Firebase
// - Updates lastSync timestamp

// initializeProgress():
// - Called on app start
// - Fetches data from Firebase if available
// - Falls back to local storage
// - Syncs data between cloud and local

// _updateStreak():
// - Called on app start
// - Checks last login date
// - Updates streak if consecutive days
// - Syncs to cloud

// ============================================
// 6. DATA RETENTION
// ============================================

// Firebase Data: Permanent (until user deletes account)
// Local Data: Until app is uninstalled or data is cleared
// Session Data: Until app is closed

// ============================================
// 7. SECURITY NOTES
// ============================================

// - Passwords: Handled by Firebase Auth (encrypted)
// - Saved credentials: Stored in OS secure storage
// - User data: Protected by Firebase security rules
// - Messages: Stored in Firestore with timestamps
// - No sensitive data in local storage (except saved credentials)

// ============================================
// 8. OFFLINE FUNCTIONALITY
// ============================================

// Works Offline:
// - View profile
// - View progress
// - Play games (local)
// - Write practice
// - View Tamil letters
// - View stories (cached)

// Requires Internet:
// - Login/Register
// - Sync progress to cloud
// - View classroom messages
// - Submit homework
// - View daily word
// - Admin functions

// ============================================
// 9. DATA BACKUP & RECOVERY
// ============================================

// Automatic Backup:
// - Every user action syncs to Firebase
// - Local storage acts as cache
// - Cloud data is primary source of truth

// Recovery:
// - If local data is lost: Restore from Firebase on next login
// - If Firebase data is lost: Restore from local cache
// - If both lost: Reset to default values

// ============================================
